title: DerivedTensorShiftIndependentUniverse
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian monoidal closed braided Grothendieck category admitting functorial flat resolutions, countable coproducts, and a derived category in an independent localization universe. Suppose $Q_h:K(C)\to D(C)$ carries its K-flat derived monoidal structure, as in [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Define $L$ to be the quotient from cochain complexes followed by $Q_h$, $L_{\mathrm{KFlat}}$ its restriction to K-flat complexes, and $F(P,K)=L(P\otimes K)$. The derived tensor comparison $L(P)\otimes^L L(K)\to F(P,K)$ is invertible for K-flat $P$ and defines a lifting of $F$ through the two localizations. Localizing the coherent Koszul tensor-shift comparisons through this lifting gives the specified two-variable coherent integer shifts on the derived tensor. Neither the construction nor the localization universe assumes equality with the Grothendieck universe.
